tasks.Calculate Sum of Digits: Calculate the sum of digits for the current element
tasks.Check Condition and Update Count: If the sum is greater than 0, increment the count
tasks.Count Positive Digit Sums: Function that counts the number of elements with a sum of digits > 0
tasks.Initialize Count Variable: Initialize count variable to zero before counting positive digit sums
tasks.Iterate Through Array: Loop through each element in the array
tasks.Return Count: Return the final count after processing all elements
